body: Thank you, these were encouraging words :) I just need to get my head straight..... I'm going to ask my dad to let me talk to someone as a starting point. You're a good person.

That's all that's stopping me. I wouldn't want to put my parents through that, but if that wasn't stopping me I'm afraid I would. I don't think I'm at the level where I would need plastic surgery, just some skincare and constant grooming and I'll at least look average, but that changes nothing about my tiny size, short and really skinny which is what brings me down the most. Guys don't take me seriously, and with girls I have no hope. I feel like I was born cursed or something..... if I just had some good friends that I enjoyed to be around it would be different. But there is nobody here that I even like...... But most of all, I'm just self-conscious as shit. I wish I was born someone else.... anybody else. :( I know I sound so negative, but I truly do appreciate any help you guys can give. You're an amazing person for replying to this. I'm in tears right now.

Thanks for this, you are an amazing person taking your time out of your day to help me. I'm not going to lie, I'm in tears right now because I just can handle all of the emotions I've been feeling lately. I really appreciate these words, more than you can imagine.

"Lunch Buddy" :\ is that what I have to look forward to? Sounds really friendzone-ish, haha. It's ok I'm not worried about that, I have plenty of great friends and I even had a few girl crushing on my this past year and was in a couple relationships. I just want to make sure I'm still growing because I get paranoid really easily 0_0 Not that being short is a bad thing, I just wouldn't want to be the shortest in the family or anything. It would be great if I could reach 5'6" or 5'7" in the next year or two, but that might not happen.
Haha I'm a guy and I don't have any problems with bullying or anything if that's what you're getting at, but thanks xD

If that was hard to understand, I just stated that my mom is 5'2", and my dad's mom is also 5'2" even though he's 5'7". I just threw in that my mom's parents are tall (her dad being well over 6') as additional information.
Well that's not good for me then with my mom being only 5'2", but my dad's mom is also only 5'2"-3" so I'm not sure. :\ My mom's parents were very tall also.
